findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_extensions, get_extension, get_metrics_history, list_keywords, get_keyword_ranks, add_keyword, remove_keyword, add_competitor, remove_competitor, list_competitors, get_keyword_serp, list_scrape_runs, get_store_listing, find_listing, search_catalog · Private data: list_extensions · Public sink: remove_keyword, find_listing · Destructive: remove_keyword, remove_competitor, list_scrape_runs.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_extensions, get_extension, get_metrics_history, list_keywords, get_keyword_ranks, add_keyword, remove_keyword, add_competitor, remove_competitor, list_competitors, get_keyword_serp, list_scrape_runs, get_store_listing, find_listing, search_catalog · Private data: list_extensions · Public sink: remove_keyword, find_listing · Destructive: remove_keyword, remove_competitor, list_scrape_runs

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
